title: Prevalence and incidence of comorbidities in patients with atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, alopecia areata, and vitiligo using a Japanese claims database.
authors: Ma Y, Chachin M, Hirose T, Nakamura K, Shi N, Hiro S, Imafuku S.
